identity_dependence_rationale: Risk is the governed subject of risk discourse composed through relations among subject/context, scenario/event/consequence and assessment; forcing it into one UFO primitive would collapse competing legitimate views. Paper-1 continuity is governed by the stable semantic identity and the explicit #69 identity/continuity contract; mutable records, descriptions, assessment results, workflow/risk states, ownership and treatment history do not determine identity automatically.
external_alignment: COVER:Risk is a Value/Quality specialization and remains related, not equivalent.
formalization_consequence: Keep a named SemRisk class/pattern without asserting gufo:Quality/Relator/Situation equivalence; do not add owl:hasKey/owl:sameAs from mutable operational fields; identity changes require explicit governed split/merge/new-identity decisions.

identity_dependence_rationale: Entities of different externally owned kinds can contingently play the role of being the subject/object-at-risk in a risk context; the role supplies no identity principle.
formalization_consequence: Model as anti-rigid roleMixin over allowed external bearers; do not create a new universal object kind.

identity_dependence_rationale: A source may be an endurant, event or situation; one UFO class spanning those categories would be invalid. Source-ness is contextual and is expressed through source/causal relations.
external_alignment: COVER/ROSE ThreatObject/ThreatEvent are narrower profile cases.
formalization_consequence: Do not force a universal superclass; represent source role through relations and typed refinements.

identity_dependence_rationale: A contextual state-of-affairs may obtain and increase susceptibility without being a causal event or intrinsic disposition.
external_alignment: NIST condition semantics; distinguished from COVER/ROSE Vulnerability.
formalization_consequence: Instances are situations; do not subtype Vulnerability.

identity_dependence_rationale: For Paper-1 Core, a Trigger is an event/occurrence that contributes to the occurrence/transition of a Risk Event. Threshold triggers remain Method/Application semantics.
formalization_consequence: Model Core trigger occurrences as Events; keep threshold-trigger values outside this class.

identity_dependence_rationale: A scenario specifies a possible/hypothesized configuration involving conditions/events/consequences; it is neither the narrative describing it nor an actual occurrence.
external_alignment: Closest-program scenario semantics; no exact COVER equivalence.
formalization_consequence: Model scenario as type/pattern of possible situations; actual Risk Event remains occurrence-level.

identity_dependence_rationale: A realized occurrence has temporal parts/boundaries and participates in causal chains; identity is occurrence-based.
external_alignment: ROSE:RiskEvent subclasses gufo:Event; COVER represents RiskEvent as EventType at type level.
formalization_consequence: Use event occurrences in SemRisk; mapping to COVER is type-level/related, to ROSE is close alignment without equivalence.

identity_dependence_rationale: Core Consequence is the resulting state-of-affairs/effect after an event/scenario; an event-like consequence may be a profile refinement.
formalization_consequence: Model outcome state separately from Impact Assessment Result.

identity_dependence_rationale: A vulnerability existentially depends on its bearer and can manifest in risk events; its identity is that of an intrinsic disposition, not a contextual situation.
formalization_consequence: Align strongly with external disposition pattern; no equivalence until #26 mapping policy.

identity_dependence_rationale: Exposure is a relational state-of-affairs involving a subject and source/context; exposure ratings/amounts are separate assessment/method values.
formalization_consequence: Model the real-world exposure condition as Situation; keep scores/amounts separate.

identity_dependence_rationale: Assessment is an occurrence performed by an actor/system over time and historically produces a result.
external_alignment: COVER/ROSE RiskAssessment is modeled as a Relator/ValueAscription, so lexical equivalence is rejected.
formalization_consequence: Use Event/Action for activity; external RiskAssessment can align to result/ascription side only through explicit mapping.

identity_dependence_rationale: A method is a repeatable specification that can be used by many assessment events and is not itself the event or result.
formalization_consequence: Model as information artifact/specification; specific methods remain profile terms.

identity_dependence_rationale: A result is an artifact/assertion generated by an assessment event and about a risk context; it can persist after the event.
external_alignment: COVER/ROSE RiskAssessment as ValueAscription is closer to this result/ascription side than to activity.
formalization_consequence: Model as information object; quantitative/ordinal value is attached rather than making the result a Quality.

identity_dependence_rationale: This is an assessment assertion/result about likelihood under a method, not the likelihood quality/disposition itself.
external_alignment: COVER:Likelihood is a Quality; therefore no equivalence.
formalization_consequence: Keep result as information object and optionally link to method-specific likelihood value/quality representation.

identity_dependence_rationale: Assessment result concerning estimated magnitude/severity; distinct from the real-world Consequence.
external_alignment: RISKMAN/NIST severity semantics are method/profile references.
formalization_consequence: Information-result specialization; no identity with Consequence.

identity_dependence_rationale: Pre-treatment context is part of the result's assessment context, not identity of a second Risk.
formalization_consequence: Keep as result specialization/context marker.

identity_dependence_rationale: Post-treatment context is part of assessment result semantics; it does not introduce another underlying Risk.
external_alignment: IOF residual-risk prior art + operational semantics.
formalization_consequence: Keep as result specialization/context marker.

ontouml_gufo_category: information object bearing contextual evidence role
identity_dependence_rationale: The same information artifact can be evidence in one assessment and not another; evidence-ness is role/context dependent.
formalization_consequence: Model artifact identity separately from its evidence role/support relation.

identity_dependence_rationale: Provenance is a relation/history pattern over entities, activities, agents, versions and derivations rather than a single SemRisk foundational entity.
formalization_consequence: Do not create one monolithic Provenance class unless needed as a packaging helper; reuse qualified PROV patterns in #26.

identity_dependence_rationale: A strategy is a chosen high-level treatment specification that can exist before execution.
formalization_consequence: Information object distinct from plan/activity/control.

identity_dependence_rationale: A plan is a prescription/specification for future activities and responsibilities, not those activities themselves.
formalization_consequence: Information object; execution relation links to activities.

identity_dependence_rationale: Treatment is performed over time and may use control mechanisms.
formalization_consequence: Event/Action distinct from Strategy/Plan/Control Mechanism.

ontouml_gufo_category: gufo:RoleMixin over endurants; control capability as intrinsic mode/disposition helper
identity_dependence_rationale: Different bearer kinds can contingently function as controls. The controlling capability is intrinsic to a bearer, while 'being used as a control' is contextual.
external_alignment: ROSE:SecurityMechanism is gufo:FunctionalComplex bearing ControlCapability disposition.
formalization_consequence: SemRisk ControlMechanism is a cross-domain roleMixin; #26 may introduce non-domain helper ControlCapability aligned to ROSE. ROSE SecurityMechanism is narrower, not equivalent.

identity_dependence_rationale: An actor becomes a Risk Owner only in a responsibility/assignment context; ownership is anti-rigid and supplies no new actor identity.
external_alignment: NIST/GRC ownership; ROSE RiskAssessor explicitly rejected as equivalence.
formalization_consequence: RiskOwner classifies external actors contingently through responsibility context.

identity_dependence_rationale: A concrete normative assignment/relator context depends on the Actor/role bearer and any explicitly modeled endurant governance participants; it carries validity/history and is about the Risk/artifact/obligation it concerns. The derived Risk pattern is not forced to be a mediated endurant.
formalization_consequence: Use a relator/assignment entity. Mediation applies to endurant participants; the governed Risk is an aboutness/assignment target through SR-REL-027. The relational risk_id is a projection shortcut, not foundational mediation.

identity_dependence_rationale: Register identity depends on governed membership/version/scope of entries rather than the identity of real-world risks.
formalization_consequence: Model as governed collection/repository of Risk Register Entries.

identity_dependence_rationale: A record is an enduring information artifact with its own version/history, distinct from the Risk it concerns.
formalization_consequence: Information object; may be member of Risk Register.

identity_dependence_rationale: A description is a textual/structured representation about a scenario; multiple descriptions can refer to the same scenario.
formalization_consequence: Information object linked by aboutness/representation.

identity_dependence_rationale: A Risk State is a time/context-bound state-of-affairs concerning the governed Risk context. It is distinct from assessment results, record/workflow progression, management attention/escalation classifications and monitoring task status.
formalization_consequence: Model as a Situation with temporal context. Management/workflow/monitoring labels stay outside Core Risk State unless a later profile explicitly introduces them.

identity_dependence_rationale: Workflow status characterizes the Risk Register Entry/process representation; values such as Open/Closed are quality values under a workflow scheme.
formalization_consequence: Model as profile/application quality/value, never as Risk State or universal domain situation.

identity_dependence_rationale: SemRisk references an external goal/objective semantic owner; it does not supply identity.
formalization_consequence: Preserve external category and map only risk linkage.

identity_dependence_rationale: SemRisk does not own capability identity. CM-PharmE Enterprise Capability is explicitly a mode in Pharma case.
formalization_consequence: Preserve external foundational typing; no local redefinition.

identity_dependence_rationale: SemRisk does not own business-process identity; Pharma bridge preserves CM-PharmE perdurant.
formalization_consequence: Preserve external category; only risk linkage local.
